response.original_title: ((FAQS Guide))-How do I reach someone on a Carnival cruise?
response.overview: To reach someone on a Carnival cruise, call Carnival's shore-to-ship line at +1-866-829-1280 (or main customer service at +1-866-829-1280) for urgent or emergency messages, or message them directly if they have internet access or a Wi-Fi plan. Carnival does not offer direct dial-in calling to passenger staterooms. Instead, shore-side staff relay urgent messages to onboard Guest Services:  Call: +1-866-829-1280 (often listed for emergency/shore-to-ship assistance) or Carnival Cruise Line at +1-866-829-1280. Carnival does not offer direct dialing to guest staterooms. For true emergencies, family members can call +1-866-829-1280 (typically Mon–Sun, 7:00 AM–10:00 PM or midnight EST). To reach Carnival Cruise Line by phone, call Customer Service at +1-866-829-1280 (Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET; Saturday–Sunday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET). You can also find phone numbers, hours, and booking/technical support details on Carnival Customer Care.
